GlobalPolicy.evidence-format: module-id, verification-ref, artifact-path, mode, editor-profile, preservation-ledger, expected, actual, verdict, collection-sync
GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Check mandatory document structure, stable anchors, and local references close to the changed artifact.
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Prove the serialized redesign unit and atomic synchronization across cards, thematic and optional interview collections, knowledge graph, verification plan, target-editor evidence, pushed commit, rendered review, complete report, and Beads status.
GlobalPolicy.phase-level-focus: Validate all GRACE XML, collection membership and data integrity, editor-profile URLs, controlled vocabulary, and GitHub rendering when shared Markdown structure changes.
GlobalPolicy.autonomy-gate: Every module requires executable or manual checks, observable artifact evidence, stop conditions, and wave or phase follow-up before autonomous edits.
GlobalPolicy.final-user-review-gate: Per-wave human approval is not required. After the technical final audit, the top-level story remains open until the user reviews and accepts the complete library.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never include secrets, credentials, private student data, or proprietary source material in repository content or evidence.

VF-001.NAME: StudentStudiesTask
VF-001.scenario: A student selects a thematic or interview collection, opens a suitable task, copies complete code to the named editor, controls hint and solution disclosure, and returns to the collection.
VF-001.expected-outcome: Root, collection, task, editor, and return links work; title and duration match; condition, code, and readiness criteria are visible; exactly three hints, the solution, self-check, and metadata are independently collapsed.

required-signals.artifact-marker: README.md collection link and CollectionEntry relative task link
target-editor instruction, complete starter code, three exact hints, and five-field metadata
required-signals.trace-sequence: HUB_OPENED -> COLLECTION_SELECTED -> TASK_OPENED -> EDITOR_OPENED -> CODE_COPIED -> HINT_1_OPTIONAL -> HINT_2_OPTIONAL -> HINT_3_OPTIONAL -> SOLUTION_OPTIONAL -> SELF_CHECK -> BROWSER_BACK

VF-002.NAME: AgentAddsTask
VF-002.scenario: An AI agent adds one task from a mentor request.
VF-002.expected-outcome: An accepted task card, exactly one thematic collection, zero or one interview, graph and verification entries, and target-editor evidence change atomically; the serialized wave closes after push, GitHub-rendered evidence, and complete report pass.

required-signals.artifact-marker: unique thematic CollectionEntry and optional interview entry
required-signals.trace-sequence: CONTRACT_READ -> MODE_AND_PROFILE_RESOLVED -> CANDIDATE_VALIDATED -> TASK_WRITTEN -> COLLECTIONS_SYNCED -> GRAPH_AND_VERIFICATION_SYNCED -> TARGET_EDITOR_PASSED -> PUSHED -> GITHUB_RENDERED -> WAVE_REPORTED -> TECHNICALLY_PUBLISHED

VF-003.NAME: AgentUpdatesTask
VF-003.scenario: An AI agent changes or migrates task content without losing the source learning goal, prerequisite, runtime assumptions, or student navigation.
VF-003.expected-outcome: CardMigrationEvidence is complete; target-editor evidence passes; thematic and optional interview data, graph and verification facts, assets, and links remain consistent; ambiguity stops before drift.

required-signals.artifact-marker: mode, editor profile, source facts, destination locations, expected, actual, and verdict
unique thematic and zero-or-one interview synchronization
required-signals.trace-sequence: CHANGE_CLASSIFIED -> SOURCE_CONTRACT_CAPTURED -> MODE_AND_PROFILE_SELECTED -> CARD_MIGRATED -> TARGET_EDITOR_PASSED -> COLLECTIONS_SYNCED -> GRAPH_AND_VERIFICATION_SYNCED -> LINKS_RESOLVED -> EVIDENCE_RECORDED

VF-004.NAME: AgentValidatesCandidate
VF-004.scenario: An agent evaluates a candidate before publication and later publishes accepted cards as one wave.
VF-004.expected-outcome: Every stable ID in the frozen candidate register receives accepted, needs-rewrite, rejected, or duplicate with evidence; only accepted enters tasks/, and the wave closes continuously after every technical publication gate passes.

required-signals.artifact-marker: Beads validation decision and evidence type
accepted card or neutral non-publication reason
required-signals.trace-sequence: StudentTaskCard -> local-completeness -> preservation -> structure -> solution-content -> target-editor -> synchronization -> rendered

VF-005.NAME: StudentNavigatesCollections
VF-005.scenario: A student follows the collection-first path and returns to the same learning context after a task.
VF-005.expected-outcome: The root hub links to the chosen collection, its task entry resolves with the correct title and duration, browser Back returns to that collection, and both task fallback links resolve to the root hub.

required-signals.artifact-marker: README.md collection link, collection README, and task navigation links
linked student title, plain-language thematic description, and exact integer duration

packet-template.expected-fields: scenario, contract-ref, mode, editor-profile, preservation-ledger, target-editor-expected, target-editor-actual, target-editor-verdict, collection-sync, expected-evidence, observed-evidence, first-divergent-artifact-or-anchor, next-action
packet-template.stop-conditions: three distinct hints unavailable; code not copy-runnable; undescribed file; ambiguous technology, editor, or profile; unnecessary multi-file split; FILE mismatch; embedded asset replacement mismatch; metadata and collection drift; duplicate thematic or interview membership; broken required link; unexpected GitHub rendering; unavailable mandatory evidence; incomplete technical publication
